summary: No determination about an advisory committee can be grounded in the FDA documents available in paperclip for BLA125288. The paperclip holdings for this application consist only of approval letters and labels (18 documents, all appletter/ or label/ URLs) across supplements from 2011-2021; none of the FDA REVIEW documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Medical Review, Risk review, Director memos) that would describe an advisory committee meeting are present. I searched the original-approval documents that are available (the 2011 approval letter and the 2011 label) for 'Advisory Committee', 'committee', 'voted', 'vote', 'recommend', 'members', and 'meeting' and found no reference to any advisory committee. Because no passage in the available documents either describes an AdComm or states that none was convened, adcom_held is set to false to reflect the absence of any documented advisory committee in the available source material; this is an absence of evidence (review documents are missing from paperclip), not a positive finding that no committee was held. no_adcom_quote is null because no verbatim FDA passage establishing 'no AC convened' exists in the available documents.
